SAND_RUSH.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

PIERCING_DRILL.name: Piercing Drill
PIERCING_DRILL.description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing ¼ of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

POISON_TOUCH.name: Poison Touch
POISON_TOUCH.description: When the Pokémon hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

OVERCOAT.name: Overcoat
OVERCOAT.description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms or hail, and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder or spores.

ANGER_POINT.name: Anger Point
ANGER_POINT.description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

SLUSH_RUSH.name: Slush Rush
SLUSH_RUSH.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

DEFIANT.name: Defiant
DEFIANT.description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted sharply.

SAP_SIPPER.name: Sap Sipper
SAP_SIPPER.description: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat.

TURBOBLAZE.name: Turboblaze
TURBOBLAZE.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

TERAVOLT.name: Teravolt
TERAVOLT.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

BULLETPROOF.name: Bulletproof
BULLETPROOF.description: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

MAGICIAN.name: Magician
MAGICIAN.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

PROTEAN.name: Protean
PROTEAN.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

GALE_WINGS.name: Gale Wings
GALE_WINGS.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

FIRE_MANE.name: Fire Mane
FIRE_MANE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50%.

GRASS_PELT.name: Grass Pelt
GRASS_PELT.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

OWN_TEMPO.name: Own Tempo
OWN_TEMPO.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

red.passive: Mark one Pokémon as your ace. It gets +2 crit stages and 1 extra level after each battle, and every win permanently raises all its stats by 4% (up to +15%). Red buys Rare Candy at half price.

lance.passive: Dragon and Flying types, and lines that evolve into them (like Lance's own team), evolve at 30% lower levels and show up more in the shop. Your team never recharges after Hyper Beam or Giga Impact. When a Dragon or Flying ally faints, adjacent Dragon and Flying allies get +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Early on, Pokémon of those lines that can still evolve get every stat raised (30% − 5% per round: +20% at round 2, gone from round 6).

steven.passive: +1G income per round, full refunds when selling, evolution stones and fossils cost 1G less. The whole team's Defense and Sp. Def grow over the run (15% + 1.35% per round: +26% at round 8, +34% at round 14), and Rock and Steel types get another +25% per adjacent stone item. Early on, every stat of the whole team, HP too, rises as well (25% − 5% per round: +15% at round 2, gone from round 5).

cynthia.passive: +0.5% to all stats for each distinct type on your team (up to 6 types). Legendary and Mythical Pokémon appear from round 11, earlier than for other champions.

alder.passive: +3.5% team Attack and Sp. Atk per 1-cell Pokémon. Bug types evolve at 30% lower levels. Bags cost 1G less.

diantha.passive: A Pokémon next to its Mega Stone Mega Evolves when its HP drops to 60% and restores 50% HP (twice per battle). A Pokémon next to the Key Stone gets +25% to every stat but HP, and Mega Evolves as the battle starts if its Mega Stone is there too.

kukui.passive: Move research: every move of your team hits harder, faster and faster as the run goes on (round² × 0.24%: +15% at round 8, +47% at round 14). Before the research builds up, moves get an extra early boost (36% − 6% per round: +24% at round 2, gone from round 6). A Pokémon next to a Z-Crystal deals ×1.8 with that type, and its first attack of that type becomes a never-missing Z-Move (4 per battle for the team). TMs cost half and appear more often.

leon.passive: Each win in a streak adds +1G income (up to +5) and +1.2% to all stats (counting up to 5 wins); a loss resets it. The Pokémon next to the Dynamax Band Dynamaxes 8 seconds in: double HP and Max Moves for 3 actions.

geeta.passive: At the end of each round, earn 1G interest per 5G held (up to 4G). A Pokémon next to a Tera Shard Terastallizes into that type as the battle starts and gets a boost to every stat but HP that grows over the run (×(1.3 + 0.015 × round): ×1.42 at round 8, ×1.51 at round 14; 3 per battle).
